title: Small States, Big Signals: AI Governance in Procurement
discussion_signal: The post argues that AI governance is already being shaped through procurement, vendor contracts, and informal staff use, creating accountability gaps when governments remain responsible but providers control system behavior. It identifies small states as early signals of wider vendor dependence and presents auditability, portability, disclosure, and escalation clauses as practical levers.
linked_research_question: How do procurement and vendor dependence shape public trust, accountability, and service access before formal AI regulation catches up?
limits: Examples are not a representative cross-country outcome study
The proposed procurement levers are not evaluated here
